text:
To stay here still, germ

of the coming song

-whole, virgin, future.


To stay asleep -intimate-

in the tender absent beating

of a deep secret presence.


And ecstasy -nourishment-

of the ignorant one -absent, pure-

unborn of clarities,

with the initial word

and the sweet intact tomorrow.

translation.title: To Stay Here Still, Germ...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the unborn, future-tense stillness of the poem's germinal song.
